title: Hermes Slack Work Orchestration
goal: Slack 사용자가 Hermes에 설계·구현 작업을 요청하면 AMPLAI가 human activation, durable Project Store, isolated workspace와 selected Claude Code 또는 Codex runner를 통해 작업을 완료하고 같은 Slack 흐름에 검증된 상태를 투영한다.

include: src/amplai_foundry/control_plane/ — orchestration request API and outbox
src/amplai_foundry/governance/ — Activation Action and Slack status projection
scripts/amplai_runtime.py, scripts/amplai_supervisor.py, scripts/amplai_hosts.py — Work runner profiles and managed workspace
standalone Hermes AMPLAI plugin and restricted Slack profile asset
tests/ and tests/ai/ — contract, recovery, host and fleet verification
exclude: simultaneous multi-runner edit of one Work

non_goals: Hermes memory를 canonical Vault로 자동 승격
하나의 Slack App credential을 Hermes와 AMPLAI가 공유
사용자 main checkout에서 autonomous worker 실행

acceptance.statement: Authorized Hermes request creates one correlated DRAFT Work graph.
Unauthorized or ambiguous requests cannot create READY or RUNNING Work.
Hermes Slack profile exposes no terminal, file edit, delegation, code execution, or raw agent launch tool.
Only a valid human Activation Action can move DRAFT Work to WAITING or READY.
Duplicate request, bridge delivery, click, and projection do not duplicate Work or decision results.
Work controller and runner profile produce the correct Claude Code or Codex public entry point while retaining one host-neutral Work contract.
Every autonomous worker runs in a managed worktree pinned to an immutable base ref.
Real Claude Code fresh and resume Work both reach a durable terminal state with evidence.
Real Codex fresh and resume Work both reach a durable terminal state with evidence.
Worker crash, supervisor restart, lease expiry, retry and attempt exhaustion follow the bounded recovery contract.
Authoritative RUNNING, HUMAN_REQUIRED, FAILED and DONE states project to Slack without secrets.
Slack plus Hermes activation is provider scoped, defaults off and does not wait for Telegram completion.
Hermes conversation and memory never auto-write canonical Vault knowledge.
Disabling the Hermes plugin and provider activation preserves existing CLI, Slack Proposal Card and direct host workflows.
All repository gates, real Slack E2E, native host E2E and three independent review lenses complete with zero blockers.

operational: real Slack Hermes request and AMPLAI Activation Card E2E
real Claude Code fresh/resume Work E2E

blocked_by: real Slack workspace and native host production-operation evidence
